description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartService in a Java-based e-commerce system. It manages shopping cart operations such as retrieval, update, merging carts, and populating cart items with product details and prices.

classes.name: ShoppingCartServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShoppingCartService managing shopping cart logic, including retrieval, update, merge, and population of cart data.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart for a customer, populating and checking if obsolete.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a shopping cart depending on whether it has an ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by ID, with optional store context, populating and removing if obsolete.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by code and store, populating and cleaning if obsolete.

methods.name: populateShoppingCart
methods.description: Populates shopping cart items with latest product details and prices.

methods.name: populateItem
methods.description: Populates a shopping cart item with product info, attributes, and price.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Creates a list of shipping products based on cart items that require shipping.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Determines if all items in the cart are free (zero final price).

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains products that require shipping.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges two shopping carts into one, combining items and updating quantities.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Helper method to clone and populate cart items from a session cart.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a shopping cart from the database.
